questionText: A man deposits Rs.1,50,000 at a CI rate of 10% p.a. After the first year's interest is credited, he withdraws 50% of the interest earned. What is his account balance at the end of the second year?

questionText: If Rs. 60,000 is invested at a compound interest of 20% p.a. for 18 months, then find the interest earned given that the sum is compounded every 6 months.
solution: Compounded every 6 months means rate per half-year = 20% ÷ 2 = 10%. Time = 18 months = 3 half-years. Amount = 60000 × (1.10)³ = 60000 × 1.331 = 79860. Interest = 79860 - 60000 = 19860.

questionText: A savings scheme offers compound interest annually. A woman deposits Rs. 10,000. At the end of the first year, the interest rate is 10%. In the second year, due to inflation, the interest rate rises to 12.5%, and in the third year, it drops to 8%. Calculate the total interest she earned at the end of 3 years.
solution: Amount after 1st year = 10000 × 1.10 = 11000. After 2nd year = 11000 × 1.125 = 12375. After 3rd year = 12375 × 1.08 = 13365. Total interest = 13365 - 10000 = Rs.3365.

questionText: An amount of Rs. 'z' is invested in two different schemes-one offers simple interest at 13% p.a. for 4 years, and the other offers compound interest at 12% p.a. compounded annually for 2 years. If the total amount from the simple interest scheme exceeds the compound interest amount by Rs. 78, then find the value of z.
solution:
Amount under SI for 4 years at 13% = z(1 + 13×4/100) = 1.52z.
Amount under CI for 2 years at 12% = z(1.12)² = 1.2544z.
Difference = 1.52z - 1.2544z = 0.2656z = 78
So z = 78 / 0.2656 ≈ 293.67 ≈ 293.66.

108 = 7500(r2/10000)

questionText: A sum of money becomes 16 times in 2 years. What is the annual compound interest rate?

options.a: A sum of money becomes 16 times in 2 years. What is the annual compound interest rate?
options.A: A sum of money becomes 16 times in 2 years. What is the annual compound interest rate?

solution:
Under compound interest:
P(1 + r/100)² = 16P
(1 + r/100)² = 16
1 + r/100 = 4
r/100 = 3
r = 300%
